text: {"verdict": "supported", "answer": "The evidence supports that inhibiting the H3K4 methyltransferase MLL1 with MM-401 efficiently reprograms mouse EpiSCs to naive pluripotency, with >50% of treated cells showing naive ESC features within 3 days and forming germline-competent chimeras. However, the excerpt attributes the effect to global redistribution of H3K4me1 at enhancers and a general perturbation of H3K4 methylation rather than explicitly to reduction of H3K4me3, so the claim's efficiency is confirmed while the specific mark named (H3K4me3) is not directly established by this evidence.", "evidence_used": ["6441369"]}
